title: Higher-image transition composition
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $a:Y\prime\to Y$, $b:Y\prime\prime\to Y\prime$, $h:Y\to S$, $h\prime:Y\prime\to S$ and $h\prime\prime:Y\prime\prime\to S$ be scheme morphisms [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] satisfying $a h=h\prime$ and $b h\prime=h\prime\prime$. Let $F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $Y_{et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] and $q\in\mathbf Z$. Write $t(a,F)$ for the canonical transition [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions], $P_{h\prime\prime}(E)=H^q(Rh\prime\prime_*E[0])$, and $c:(ba)^*\simeq b^*a^*$ for the pullback composition comparison [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Then $t(ba,F)=t(a,F)\,t(b,a^*F)\,P_{h\prime\prime}(c^{-1}_F)$. More generally, for sheaves $F\prime$ on $Y\prime$ and $F\prime\prime$ on $Y\prime\prime$, maps $f:a^*F\to F\prime$ and $g:b^*F\prime\to F\prime\prime$, transition along the composite followed by the coefficient map $c_F\,b^*(f)\,g$ equals transition along $a$ followed by $f$, then transition along $b$ followed by $g$.

source.place: Tags 09Z1 and 03Q8, canonical comparisons; formal adjunction calculation for these comparisons

proof.text: Use [lem-sbc-lower-star-plus-transition-comp] for the derived transition composition at F[0]. Then Before homology, expand both transitions as the adjoints of the pulled-back counits. Express the unit for the composite pullback adjunction as the successive units, transported through the inverse-image composition comparison. Naturality moves the middle unit past the first counit; the triangle identity cancels this pair. Associativity of the pullback comparisons identifies the remaining expression with the transition for `b ≫ a`. For a sheaf placed in degree zero, the exact-functor comparison with singleFunctor commutes with composition: compute on the degree-zero complex using the factorization through the homotopy category. This identifies the remaining derived pullback comparison with singleFunctor applied to the ordinary pullback comparison. Apply homology, preserving compositions. The equalities of the three structure morphisms occur only as proof-irrelevant transports. Apply coefficient naturality to move f across the second transition; the maps g and the comparison compose by functoriality. The generic source-library derived pullback identity and associativity comparisons apply to ModuleCat coefficients; the abelian-group-only derivedInverseImageComposition theorem is not used. Its present module imports the source Transition module, which reaches the parent coherence module, so a direct import here would be cyclic; the future proof must relocate that existing lemma rather than restate it.

lean.statement:
theorem higher_direct_image_transition_composition
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {S Y Y' Y'' : Scheme.{u}}
    (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (b : Y'' ⟶ Y') (h : Y ⟶ S) (h' : Y' ⟶ S) (h'' : Y'' ⟶ S)
    (wa : a ≫ h = h') (wb : b ≫ h' = h'') (q : ℤ)
    (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (F' : Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (F'' : Sheaf Y''.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (f : ((a)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj F ⟶ F')
    (g : ((b)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj F' ⟶ F'') :
    higherDirectImageTransition Λ (b ≫ a) h h''
        (by rw [Category.assoc, wa, wb]) q F ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).map
        (R+((h'')_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map
          ((upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) b a).hom.app F ≫
            ((b)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map f ≫ g))) =
      (higherDirectImageTransition Λ a h h' wa q F ≫
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).map
          (R+((h')_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map f))) ≫
      (higherDirectImageTransition Λ b h' h'' wb q F' ≫
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).map
          (R+((h'')_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map g)))
